page.layout: One column of running text on the left printed page; the right side of the scan is the book's binding edge with no print. Running head above the text. Signature mark at the foot of the text block. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: tes profert, atque efficit: vt qui locorum sunt interuallo disiuncti, inter se tamen colloquātur, eademq; fere absentes, quae si coram essent, consequantur: commen-dent amicos: in viam quasi aberrantes reducant: aduersa pressos fortuna erigat ac solentur: praestent alia, quae literis credi committiq;[?] solent: atque ita praestent, vt rei ipsius, qua de agitur, ratio habea-tur: spectetur tempus: personae confide-rentur: non negligātur caetera, sine qui-bus, id quod difficile, decorum retineri nullo modo potest? Artem vero quis a-spernabitur: parui aut nihili exempla fa-ciet: nullo imitationem loco numerabit, nisi illud qui ignorauerit, quemadmo-dum omnibus in rebus aliis, ita epistolis quoque hoc illa praestare: vt facilius, re-ctius, felicius, quae fierinecesse est, fiant: non nisi diuturna cum obseruatione, tū exercitatione habitum parari atque im

page.notes: The right side of the scan shows only the binding edge, not printed text. The word "committiq;" at the line end is hard to read and is marked [?]. "pressos" is read from the ligature "preffos" and may be a slight misreading. The page ends mid-sentence on "atque im", continuing on the next page. No catchword is printed.
